meta.title: Balance Sentinel
meta.description: DeepSeek low-balance alerts pushed to Feishu/DingTalk IM; no API key on hosts with the official account service.

sub: DeepSeek balance watch · proactive low-balance alerts
reason.title: Balance unavailable
reason.unauthorized: API key invalid or expired: update the key, or sign in with the host account (no key).
reason.network: Network unreachable: make sure this machine can reach api.deepseek.com (proxy/firewall?).
banner: Watching, but notifications are not connected: set a channel and low balance will push to your IM.
alert.pending: A "{k}" notice is waiting to be sent.
monitor.off: Background monitoring is off (balance.enabled=false); the panel is display-only.
quiet.on: Quiet hours {s}–{e}: alerts defer and merge into one push afterwards.
th.title: Alert thresholds
th.bad: Positive numbers required, warn above critical.
th.hint: Below warn pushes "low", below critical pushes "critical"; a top-up back above warn pushes one "recovered". Threshold tweaks or undelivered alerts cancel silently.
push.hint: Low-balance / recovery notices push here. Saving applies immediately, no restart.
push.empty: No push channel yet. Save a URL and get IM alerts when the balance runs low.
push.saved: Saved; applies from the next push.
push.disabled: Push turned off; configure it again anytime.
push.testOk: Test push via {c} succeeded, {n} message(s) sent.
bridge.title: The panel cannot reach the host: bridge not running, port taken, or the page environment blocks it. Copy the config into the webhook field of state.json and restart DSH.
bridge.snippetCopied: Snippet copied; paste into the webhook field of state.json, then restart DSH.
